resources.string: Independent application, not affiliated with Proton.

Create simple events from your calendar app, without reminders, guests, recurrence or custom colors. Changes stay local unless title synchronization is explicitly enabled. Deletions are not sent to Proton.

Titles only: timed or all-day events without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Includes events imported from Proton and those created in Android after their first successful sync. Date, description and location changes stay on Android.
Creations waiting or requiring attention: %1$d. An uncertain send is never repeated automatically.
Synchronization with Android encountered a problem. Your data is retained.

Simple timed or all-day events without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Includes Proton events and Android-created events after their first successful sync. A title changed together with the description or location is included. Date-only changes use the separate time option. Combined date and text changes stay on Android. Deletions of supported imported events use a separate option.
Read-only by default. Creation, title, text, time and deletion each have a separate option. Unsupported changes stay on Android; pending work is retained.

For title-only changes to simple events. Use the separate text option for description and location changes. Date-only changes use the separate time option. Combined date and text changes stay on Android. Deletions of supported imported events use a separate option.

Simple timed or all-day events only, without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Change dates or duration while keeping the event type, time zone and other fields unchanged. Combined date and text changes stay on Android. Deletions of supported imported events use a separate option.
Simple imported events only, without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Other deletions stay on Android.
